steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Where's the kid? How is she?

The gray-haired girl is still standing on the path where Ted left, stopping you. Her body is disintegrating, with every cell being extracted, turning into more dense contamination. She shows no intention of giving way.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She's really determined to stop us. Does she want to fight us herself next?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, don't hesitate. You have a mission to accomplish. You can't let Ted get there first.
Anne barely manages to hold herself up. The bloodstain on her nurse uniform is spreading quickly.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: I'll fight with you guys. Let me stop that kid.
She picks up a syringe with her shivering hand—the color of the serum has changed. She injects a full tube of the orange liquid into herself then stands up.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is that a booster? She used her ability to change the serum's attributes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hold on! Your injury... You're pushing yourself too hard! It'll kill you!

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Are you worrying about me? Thanks, I'm fine.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: She is the one who's really suffering.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: That kid's body has reached its limit. If she keeps fighting like this, she will soon be consumed by Mania.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nothing will work. She has been domesticated and given up thinking. She only acts on Ted's orders.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: She doesn't want to become a monster. She just... wants to go back.
